Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

What is the LG Dashain Tihar Offer 2083?

“LG Ko Uphaar, Manaun Dashain ra Tihar” is an LG festive promotion in Nepal featuring up to 25% cash discount on selected products, gifts with eligible appliances, and no-cost EMI on selected products.

Which LG products qualify for cash discounts?

Selected TVs except 32-inch models, audio systems, vacuum cleaners, single-door refrigerators, and double-door refrigerators up to 308 litres qualify for special cash discounts. Eligibility and discount amounts vary by model.

What gifts come with LG washing machines?

Eligible front-load washing machines include 6 kg of Surf Excel Matic detergent; top-load models include 4 kg of Surf Excel detergent; twin-tub models include 2 kg of Surf Excel detergent.

What free gifts are available with the products?

Free gifts include:
• Washing Machine: Surf Excel Detergent (6kg for Front Load, 4kg for Top Load, & 2kg for Twin Tub)
• Refrigerator: 550W Mixer Grinder (on selected models)
• Air Conditioner: Free Professional Installation
• Microwave Oven: Free Cooking Kit
Gifts may vary by product and stock availability.

Is 0% EMI available? What are the requirements?

Yes, 0% EMI facility is available. You only need your Credit Card of our EMI parther banks. Easy installments are provided through partner banks and finance companies.

How long is the LG Dashain Tihar Offer valid?

The offer is valid for a limited time only. Please check the website or contact CG Digital for the exact expiry date.

Where can I purchase the products under this offer?

You can purchase from the official CG Digital website (cgdigital.com.np), CG Digital & LG Shoppe showrooms, or any authorized LG dealer across Nepal.

Are the offer prices inclusive of VAT?

Yes, all displayed offer prices are inclusive of VAT. Any additional government taxes will be applicable as per rules.

Do I get free delivery and installation?

Free professional installation is provided with Air Conditioners. Free delivery is available on selected high-value products. Please confirm at the time of purchase.

What is the warranty and after-sales service?

All LG products come with standard manufacturer warranty. CG Electronics provides reliable after-sales service across Nepal.
